meta.title: Start: book the free 30-minute call
meta.description: Book a free 30-minute call, message us on WhatsApp or write to us. We look at your business together and show you where clients are slipping away.

hero.title: Three ways to start. Pick the one that suits you.
hero.lead: The call is the quickest: thirty minutes looking at your actual business. You leave knowing where clients slip away and what to fix first, with us or on your own.

call.title: Book the free call
call.text: Pick a time that works. You'll get a confirmation and a reminder. Nothing to prepare.
points: A clear look at how people find you now, from the outside.
The two or three spots where clients slip away.
What to fix first, and what it would change.
call.placeholderNote: The booking calendar appears here once the Cal.com link is set in src/config/site.ts.
call.open: Open the calendar in a new tab

whatsapp.title: Message us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Rather type than talk? Tell us in two lines what you do and where it gets stuck. A person answers, usually the same day.

form.title: Or write to us
form.text: We read every message ourselves and reply within two working days.
form.name: Your name
form.messageHint: Two or three lines is plenty.
form.privacy: We use what you write only to reply to you.

thanks.title: Got it. Thank you.
thanks.text: Your message is with us. One of the two of us will reply within two working days, usually sooner.
